excerpts.heading: Period Markets
excerpts.excerpt: Every odds endpoint accepts an optional period query param. Omitted = full game (default; backwards-compatible). Pass canonical codes or all to opt in.

excerpts.heading: Period Markets
excerpts.excerpt: Every market row in the response carries a period field (string or null for full game), so consumers can branch on it without re-parsing the URL.

excerpts.heading: Period Markets
excerpts.excerpt: Football q4 excludes overtime. Football 2nd-half markets stay ungraded on games that go to overtime, because books disagree on whether OT counts. Period player props are not graded.

excerpts.heading: Bulk Export
excerpts.excerpt: Streams every resolved prop outcome as a CSV download — ideal for backtesting, model training, and statistical research.

excerpts.heading: Player Stats
excerpts.excerpt: When status is in_progress , treat the numbers as partial; once it flips to final , they are the official box score.

excerpts.heading: What is prop resolution?
excerpts.excerpt: After the game finishes, the resolver compares the actual stat from the league's official box score to the line on every Over and Under we recorded — then writes a verdict ( won / lost / push / void ) and the actual value back onto each outcome.

excerpts.heading: Notes
excerpts.excerpt: Grading is PropLine's, against the league's official box score — not each book's house rules.
